create_scene3d: create a Scene3D instance to hold 3D objects in the Magnum scenegraph
create_object3d: create an Object3D instance with a parent scene or object in the scenegraph
test_transform_local_numpy: test applying a numpy 4x4 matrix as a local transformation on an Object3D
test_translate_numpy: test translating an Object3D using a numpy float32 array for the translation vector
test_absolute_transformation: test retrieving the absolute world-space transformation matrix of a child Object3D
